title: Platform Integration Snap Deck (Prototype)
content:
Audience: SEs, Sales Managers, Field Ops
Purpose: 3–8 slide mini-deck for quick pre-call alignment and a 2-min demo script that highlights integration speed and fallback economics. Not final — this is a compact prototype to iterate with SEs.

Slide 1 — One-liner + Hook
  Title: ‘Integrate, Serve, Scale — In 60 Minutes (Pilot Ready)’
  Notes: fast opener for 30–45 minute technical discovery. Emphasize predictable latency not just model accuracy. Hook examples: ‘Take a reference app from sandbox to pilot with RBAC + canary in under 1 hour.’

Slide 2 — Target persona & pain
  Title: ‘Who this helps’
  Bullets:
    - Platform / infra engineer: wants deterministic tail latency and predictable spend
    - Product engine: needs fast iteration and safe rollouts (canaries, A/B)
    - Security/compliance: needs VPC, KMS, audit logs
  Quick note: call out common objections (too risky to run large models, procurement cycles, SLA mismatch) — prepare rebuttals under appendix.

Slide 3 — Integration flow (3 steps)
  Title: ‘Snap integration flow — demo script’
  Steps:
    1) Provision a dev API key + attach to a small dedicated pool (SE script attaches to sample app)
    2) Configure route: prefer latency SLO, fallback to cheaper quantized variant on burst
    3) Canary deploy 5% traffic for 10 minutes, run smoke prompts, check cost delta in console
  Speaker cues: call out where to show the Console quick metrics (tokens/sec, avg latency).

Slide 4 — Demo talking points & quick checks
  Title: ‘2-min live demo script’
  Script bullets:
    - 0:00–0:20: show model catalog, pick curated model, point at perf profile (p99, throughput)
    - 0:20–0:50: show routing policy + canary toggles, start canary
    - 0:50–1:20: send 3 sample requests (chat, rerank, embedding) — highlight streaming + token cost
    - 1:20–2:00: show fallback event log and cost snapshot, call out expected cost reduction from auto-batching
  Quick checks list (SE checklist): environment variables set, route configured, canary percent, smoke prompts available.

Slide 5 — Risk & fallback economics (one table slide)
  Title: ‘Fallbacks that keep you online’
  Short bullets:
    - Policy patterns: region-fallback, quantized-fallback, model-family-fallback
    - When to use each: latency spike -> region fallback; cost pressure -> quantized-fallback; quality regression -> family fallback with A/B evals
    - Talking nugget: ‘Fallbacks preserve user-facing latency while keeping unit cost within budget.’

Slide 6 — Battle-ready rebut bullets (rapid responses for SEs)
  Title: ‘Objection flashcards’
  Each card = 20–40 word seller response:
    - ‘We need on-prem only’ -> quick: ‘We support Private deployments with customer-managed control plane + HSM integrations; we can ship a pilot package.’
    - ‘Latency jitter kills UX’ -> quick: ‘Show p50/p95/p99 on console; enable region pins + KV prefix caching.’
    - ‘Procurement says vendor lock-in risk’ -> quick: ‘Open model catalog + exportable model artifacts; migration path documented.’

Slide 7 — Playbook: pilot success checklist (handout)
  Title: ‘Pilot 7-point launch checklist (for SEs & AE)’
  Items:
    - Pre-call: confirm customer scope, SLO targets, sample prompts
    - Provision: create dev key, allocate small Dedicated pool or Private sandbox
    - Instrument: attach tracing hooks, enable token metrics, add smoke prompts to canary
    - Safety: enable rate limits, function-calling constraints, logging to secure bucket
    - Execute: run 1-hour smoke + 24-hour soft canary, collect evals
    - Validate: compare cost & latency to baseline, run small AB test if needed
    - Close: propose next steps (reserved capacity estimate, SSO/KMS onboarding)

Appendix (notes & open questions)
  - Audience-specific slides to build: procurement one-pager, networking checklist (VPC peering steps), security deep-dive
  - Open question: should we include a canned terraform snippet for provider onboarding? (ask infra-eng).
  - Dependencies: need a short internal video (3m) that walks the console steps for SEs — assign to Marisol.

Next steps (owner actions)
  - Iterate with 2 SEs this week and capture live Q&A in the deck
  - Convert to 6-slide printable cheat-sheet for field that fits in CRM record
  - Hook: capture 3 pilot metrics templates (latency, cost per 1k tokens, correctness delta) for sales reporting

Notes to self (rough):
  - Keep language punchy; this is a rapid-deploy narrative (time-to-value is our differentiator)
  - Avoid deep infra diagrams here; link to separate VPC onboarding doc for technical handoff
  - Make slide visuals: left column flow, right column console screenshots, footer with one-line call to action and contact (AE + SE).

References and bookmarks (internal):
  - Pilot runbook: confluence/PLATFORM-PILOT-RUNBOOK (linked in linked_artifacts)
  - Demo repo: github/platform-demo/quick-snap (linked)

—— end prototype — notes: this is intentionally compact; goal is to produce a repeatable 3–5 minute field opener and a 2-minute demo that an SE can run without deep ops help.
